description: This file defines a command class for running scenarios in a distributed test client application. It sets up command-line options for scenario parameters and initializes a runner to execute the scenario. Additionally, it provides a static method to create instances of this command.

classes.name: ScenarioCommand<T>
classes.description: A command class inheriting from Command that sets up options and execution logic for a specific scenario.

methods.name: ScenarioCommand<T>
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the command with options and a handler.
